description: This file defines an interface 'HttpConfig' that specifies configuration settings for a Ditto HTTP endpoint, including hostname, port, and shutdown timeout, along with an inner enum 'HttpConfigValue' containing default configuration values.

classes.name: HttpConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration methods for the HTTP service, including hostname, port, and shutdown timeout.

classes.name: HttpConfig.HttpConfigValue
classes.description: Enum listing known configuration keys and their default values for HttpConfig, implementing KnownConfigValue.

methods.name: getHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the HTTP endpoint as a String.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the HTTP endpoint as an integer.

methods.name: getCoordinatedShutdownTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout Duration for coordinated shutdown.
